What
you
have. Eight A3 classroom posters for the Jurassic English™ thinking routine, in English
and Vietnamese: the Thinking Cycle, the four parts of an argument (Claim, Evidence, Interpretation,
Warrant), Word Fossils, the Butterﬂy Hug, and Accountable Talk.

(297 x 420 mm). This licensed PDF shows the same eight posters at A4 size, so you can also print on

ấn. File A3 gốc (297 x 420 mm) nằm trong tệp riêng. Tệp PDF này hiển thị tám áp phích ở khổ A4; bạn
có thể in A4 hoặc chọn “vừa trang” cho mọi khổ giấy.
Where
to
hang
them. Posters 1 and 8 near the board. Posters 2 to 5 side by side in a row, in the
order C, E, I, W, so children can follow the argument across the wall. Poster 6 beside the Word
Wall. Poster 7 near the door or the reading corner.
